items.headline: Illinois QB Katin Houser out 4-6 weeks after hand procedure
items.description: Illinois starting QB Katin Houser will miss four to six weeks after undergoing a procedure on his throwing hand, coach Bret Bielema announced Wednesday.

items.headline: Illinois loses QB Katin Houser to broken hand in win
items.description: Illinois quarterback Katin Houser will be out indefinitely after leaving Saturday's 38-37 win over Michigan State with a left hand injury, coach Bret Bielema said.
